slides.title: 226 students. One *assistant.*
slides.lead: How a drum school stopped running on spreadsheets.

slides.label: BEFORE
slides.title: Everything was *manual.*
slides.body: Classes were confirmed by message, student by student, every week.

slides.label: BEFORE
slides.title: Fees lived in *sheets.*
slides.body: Payment details were shared one by one. Someone checked who had paid. Student lists sat in spreadsheets.

slides.label: RESULT
slides.title: 10 hours back *every week.*
slides.body: As reported for KDC. The assistant stopped chasing confirmations.

slides.title: Book a *discovery call.*
slides.lead: We find the leak first. Then we build.
